description: Six Fallout Shelter-style raider personas, each with a default and an action pose, used by the wasteland encounter, arena/incident scenes and the dev asset gallery.
method: OpenAI Images API /v1/images/edits with gpt-image-2.5-flare, quality high, transparent background, PNG output; post-processed with Pillow to a 902px-tall WebP with alpha at quality 90.
rights: Fallout Shelter artwork belongs to its original rights holders. These are style-matched re-renders, not original game artwork and carry no independent license.

assets.name: Jinx
assets.postprocess: horizontally mirrored right-to-left; Lanczos fit to 902px height; WebP quality 90 with alpha preserved
assets.prompt: Use the supplied image as the exact style and character reference. Keep the same character identity, magenta pink mohawk, shaved sides, face, clothing, colors and Fallout Shelter flat cartoon style. Replace the weapon with a proper Fallout pipe rifle: a wooden stock, a metal receiver with a visible bolt and trigger guard, a box magazine, a long barrel and a front sight. Hold the rifle low across her body with both hands in the same standing ready stance, head and eyes turned to the viewer's right like the other raiders. One character only, complete silhouette from hair to boots, centered with generous empty margins, no ground shadow, no background, no other characters, no text, no watermark.
